name: Fareed Zakaria
role: Indian-born American journalist, CNN host and author
summary: Zakaria defends constitutional liberalism, with rule of law, separated powers and independent institutions such as central banks and courts, over unchecked majority rule, and criticises direct democracy and premature democratisation. He favours open trade and legal immigration, a Nordic-style market economy with safety nets, a carbon tax and global cooperation among sovereign states, and says the left-right divide is obsolete.
